notes: Copied from the College Park ccjs-major plan, since the requirements match; constructed (official: false).

No official term-by-term 4-year plan exists in the fetched sources (only a college checklist and a two-year plan for A.A. transfer students, neither a full 8-term grid), so this plan is constructed from the department's own major requirements instead (docs/project/owner-review.md flags this as constructed). Gen Ed slots are left out entirely: only the major is audited.
Gateway Math is filled with STAT100 (department page prefers STAT100 for the Advanced Statistics prerequisite chain); any of the five listed options would satisfy the requirement equally.
Advanced Statistics is filled with CCJS200 itself (the default, not one of the approved substitutes).
CCJS Criminal Justice Courses (select two of CCJS340/342/345) filled with CCJS340 and CCJS342.
CCJS Criminology/Theory Course (select one of CCJS450/451/454) filled with CCJS454.

CCJS Courses of Choice (400-level, 2 courses) filled with CCJS405 and CCJS418, both real CCJS courses from the Academic Catalog's approved-course list, chosen only to satisfy the level/count requirement.
CCJS Courses of Choice (any-level, 2 courses) filled with CCJS310 and CCJS330, both real CCJS courses from the Academic Catalog's approved-course list, chosen only to satisfy the count requirement.
